suggestions: materialize frequently used subqueries into CTEs
pre-filter title table into CTE to reduce join rows
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
WITH it1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id
    FROM info_type
    WHERE info = 'genres'
),
it2 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id
    FROM info_type
    WHERE info = 'votes'
),
filtered_titles AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id, title
    FROM title
    WHERE production_year > 2000
      AND (title LIKE '%Freddy%' OR title LIKE '%Jason%' OR title LIKE 'Saw%')
)
SELECT MIN(mi.info) AS movie_budget,
       MIN(mi_idx.info) AS movie_votes,
       MIN(n.name) AS writer,
       MIN(t.title) AS violent_liongate_movie
FROM filtered_titles AS t
JOIN movie_info AS mi ON t.id = mi.movie_id
JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON t.id = mi_idx.movie_id
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON t.id = ci.movie_id
JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON t.id = mk.movie_id
JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON t.id = mc.movie_id
JOIN it1 ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id
JOIN it2 ON it2.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
JOIN keyword AS k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
WHERE ci.note IN ('(writer)', '(head writer)', '(written by)', '(story)', '(story editor)')
  AND cn.name LIKE 'Lionsgate%'
  AND k.keyword IN ('murder', 'violence', 'blood', 'gore', 'death', 'female-nudity', 'hospital')
  AND mc.note LIKE '%(Blu-ray)%'
  AND mi.info IN ('Horror', 'Thriller')
  AND n.gender = 'm'
